intro.text: This is our AI assistant Vera. She will ask you a few questions about your cough before I examine you.

cough.text: I have had a dry cough for about three days and it keeps me up at night.

cough-onset.text: It started on Monday after my son had a cold, and it is getting a little worse.

cough-meds.text: Honey and tea help a bit. I took some cough syrup last night.

es-cough.text: Tengo tos seca desde hace tres días y no me deja dormir.
